6866.title: Codex child processes ignore the selected session home
6866.rootCauseOneLine: The launch environment overlays only pool routing variables, dropping CODEX_HOME; session reuse also omits the home from its construction signature.
6866.proposedFix: Forward a validated effective home through the existing sanitization path and define safe saved-session home affinity before rebuilding on home changes.
6866.caveats: Verified with real bridge child launches and the repository protocol fake in two clean checkouts, not native authenticated accounts. No automated PR: authentication/session-storage semantics exceed the simple-fix boundary. Reproduction test is inline per reports repository policy.
